title: Sable and the Trail
premise: Ulyana Eriksen flies medicine and gossip across the interior, hiding from a family debt and a name she'd rather forget. When her old rival Dario Vance hires her crew to retrieve an inheritance sealed inside a wrecked riverboat—the very job that got her father killed—she refuses until the debt collectors force her hand. Stranded by the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger named Sable who knows more about the wreck than she admits, Ulyana must choose between the payment that frees her and the truth about what her father really left behind. In the end she outlasts the flood, exposes Dario's betrayal, claims the inheritance as a found-family trust rather than a fortune, and finally stops running.
about_author: Mirabel Oyelaran is a former bush-strip radio operator turned novelist who writes adventure stories rooted in river country and the people who keep remote places supplied. She lives between two small airfields and one unreliable canoe.

chapters.title: Fuel, Debt, and Weather
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. She runs her last medical flight of the season while dodging a creditor at the airstrip, establishing her debts, her compass keepsake, and her rule: never fly the Sable River route. Emotional beat: weary self-containment masking grief.

chapters.title: The Rival's Offer
chapters.summary: Dario Vance arrives with a contract to salvage cargo from the wrecked riverboat Kestrel's Promise on the forbidden trail. Ulyana throws him out, but he leaves behind a photo proving he knows about her father's final flight. Beat: old anger reignited.

chapters.title: The Crew Says Yes
chapters.summary: Mechanic Bea and deckhand Tomas reveal the creditors have bought their strip's lease; only Dario's advance can save it. Ulyana's POV fractures between duty to her found family and the vow to her dead father. Beat: reluctant surrender.

chapters.title: Loading the Leaking Boat
chapters.summary: Bea's POV. The crew preps the river barge for the monsoon-window run; Ulyana secretly packs her father's old charts. A stranger, Sable, talks her way aboard as a paying passenger headed upriver. Beat: uneasy new variable.

chapters.title: First Rapids
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. The journey begins; Sable proves unnervingly competent on the water and asks pointed questions about the Kestrel. Ulyana catches her studying the wreck coordinates. Beat: suspicion sharpening into curiosity.

chapters.title: Monsoon Warning
chapters.summary: Tomas's POV. Radio reports a long monsoon cell closing the upper river; they can push through or turn back. Dario's satellite messages grow demanding. The crew votes to continue. Beat: point of no return.

chapters.title: What Sable Knows
chapters.summary: Sable's POV, first time. She reveals she grew up on the Kestrel—her mother was its cook—and she believes the inheritance includes letters proving the crew were cheated, not thieves. Beat: alliance forming over shared loss.

chapters.title: Night Camp Confessions
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. Rain-bound in camp, Sable tells how her mother died waiting for a rescue that never came because Ulyana's father turned back. Ulyana confesses the debt isn't money—it's guilt. Beat: raw honesty, fragile trust.

chapters.title: The Hull Gives Way
chapters.summary: Bea's POV. The barge strikes submerged debris; the hull splits in rising water. They beach it in a flooded side-channel, losing half their fuel and the radio antenna. Beat: crisis, competence under panic.

chapters.title: Stranded Together
chapters.summary: Tomas's POV. Repairs stall; tempers flare when Dario's message demands they abandon salvage if delayed. Sable quietly patches the leak better than anyone expected. Beat: grudging respect hardening into loyalty.

chapters.title: Dario's Second Boat
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. From a ridge, Ulyana spots a second vessel shadowing them—Dario never intended to share the find. She realizes the contract was bait to locate the wreck using her father's charts. Beat: betrayal understood.

chapters.title: The Sworn-Off Job
chapters.summary: Sable's POV. She shares her mother's hidden journal: the Kestrel's 'stolen' cargo was deliberately scuttled by its owners to cheat the crew, and Ulyana's father discovered it. Beat: the past rewritten; duty inverted.

chapters.title: Charts in the Compass Case
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. She finally opens her father's compass case and finds his annotated route to the true hold—not the manifest hold Dario expects. Her father wasn't fleeing the job; he was finishing it. Beat: inheritance redefined.

chapters.title: Racing the Dry Season
chapters.summary: Bea's POV. With repairs holding barely, they make a break for the wreck site before waters drop and strand them—or before Dario's boat arrives first. Beat: momentum, hope with teeth.

chapters.title: The Kestrel's Grave
chapters.summary: Tomas's POV. They reach the half-submerged wreck at dusk. Diving conditions are lethal; Sable volunteers to guide them through the flooded corridors she memorized as a child. Beat: awe and dread.

chapters.title: Into the Hold
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. Inside the wreck, they find the strongbox—and evidence her father reached it first and left it sealed, choosing lives over loot during the original disaster. Beat: grief transfigured into pride.

chapters.title: Ambush at Anchor
chapters.summary: Sable's POV. Dario's crew takes them by surprise at anchor, seizing the strongbox and stranding the group as the last storm front hits. Beat: lowest point, everything lost.

chapters.title: Storm Fight
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. Climax: in the monsoon's worst hours, Ulyana uses her flying instincts—reading wind and water—to ram and board Dario's boat, while Sable confronts him with the journal. Beat: courage against fury.

chapters.title: What the River Keeps
chapters.summary: Tomas's POV. Dario's boat founders; the crew saves Dario's men but not the strongbox, which sinks beyond reach. Dario, broken, confesses the scuttling on tape via the repaired radio. Beat: justice without treasure.

chapters.title: Dry Season Dawn
chapters.summary: Bea's POV. Waters recede; the patched barge limps home down the open trail. The confession clears both fathers' names and voids the fraudulent debt. Beat: exhaustion turning to lightness.

chapters.title: Inheritance
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. Back home, the salvaged letters—not gold—are authenticated, restoring the drowned crew's pensions and the airstrip lease. Ulyana signs nothing for herself. Beat: love against duty resolved.

chapters.title: Sable and the Trail
chapters.summary: Shared POV, alternating voices. Sable stays on as partner; the crew repaints the barge with both families' names. Ulyana flies the Sable River route again, compass steady. Final beat: homecoming, found family complete.
